title: A Beetle Smaller Than a Coin Can Pull Six Buses

scenes.text: Smaller than a coin. Strong enough to drag six buses.
scenes.keywords: dung beetle pushing ball close up

scenes.text: It's a horned dung beetle called Onthophagus taurus.
Scientists measured it pulling 1,141 times its own body weight.
For a person, that's like dragging six double decker buses.
The researchers, at Queen Mary University of London and the University of Western Australia, tested it for months.
It was crowned the world's strongest insect.
Smaller than a coin. Six buses.

description:
Smaller than a coin, strong enough to drag six buses.
